# opnsense_firewall_group (Resource)

Interface groups (Firewall > Groups). A group gets its own rules tab, and rules on it apply to every member interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Put the guest and IoT VLANs in one group so a single rule set covers both.
resource "opnsense_firewall_group" "untrusted" {
  name        = "untrusted"
  members     = ["opt2", "opt3"]
  description = "Guest and IoT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `members` (Set of String) Member interfaces, by identifier (e.g. `wan`, `lan`, `opt1`). At least one is required.
- `name` (String) Group name, up to 15 characters; it may not start or end with a digit. Firewall rules and aliases refer to the group by this name, so renaming it can break those references.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to `""`.
- `no_group` (Boolean) Hide the group from the interface menu, so it doesn't get its own rules tab. Defaults to `false`.
- `sequence` (Number) Ordering of the group in the menu. Defaults to `0`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_firewall_group.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
